description.en: Over 150 animated components crafted for landing pages and modern products.
description.zh: 专为营销落地页与现代 Web 产品量身定制的顶级 React 动效组件库。

content.en: Magic UI is a premier open-source collection of over 150 animated components built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Motion. Designed specifically for high-conversion landing pages and modern developer products, Magic UI popularised effects like Bento Grids, Globe visualizers, Shimmer buttons, and animated retro grids.
content.zh: Magic UI 是由 Dillion Verma 创立并风靡设计工程师圈子的开源动效组件库。全库收录超 150 款精美控件，深度适配 shadcn 架构，引领了 Bento Grid 矩阵、3D 交互地球、发光粒子线条、流光边框按钮与复古网格背景等现代落地页设计潮流。
